verdict.rationale: Termius says hosts store IPs, ports and passwords so you "connect instantly" without re-entering them (termius-docs-1). Keychain items such as keys and credentials can be reused across many hosts and groups (termius-docs-3, termius-docs-12), and saved hosts sync to every device after login (termius-docs-29). Community worries about storing credentials in a third-party app are general skepticism, not a contradiction; missing for 10: no explicit documentation of the one-tap connect flow from the host list, no independent hands-on confirmation of instant saved-host connection.
